contracts_rationale: No network/API interface; the only new surface is CLI flags on internal gate scripts, documented in data-model.md.
purpose_context: The PR #171 landing left three follow-ups. The draft gates guess envDir/envFile by searching config text, so a setting in an imported base config is missed and the gate silently reads the wrong .env file (#173). The _links dead-link check only accepts an index at api/index.json, so a site using a custom indexPath cannot pass it (#172). sitemapDraftFilter still sits in config.ts instead of its integration module (#174).
purpose_tldr: Make DocKitty's build gates read the site's real Astro config and agent-API index path, and finish the config.ts split.
